items.title: Protein disulphide isomerase protects against ALS/FTD phenotypes associated with cyclin F in zebrafish and cellular models.
items.summary: Mutations in CCNF , encoding cyclin F, cause a small proportion of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) and frontotemporal dementia (FTD) cases. Mutant cyclin F mislocalises from the nucleus to the cytoplasm, impairs the ubiquitin proteasome system, disrupts endoplasmic reticulum (ER) to Golgi transport, and triggers ER stress and apoptosis. Protein disulphide isomerase (PDI), a redox-active ER chaperone of the thioredoxin superfamily, protects against ALS phenotypes induced by mutant SOD1, TDP-43, and FUS, but its activity against mutant cyclin F has not been examined. To test whether PDI overexpression prevents the cellular and behavioural phenotypes induced by the ALS/FTD-associated cyclin F S621G mutation. Neuro-2a cells were co-transfected with mCherry-tagged wild-type or mutant cyclin F S621G and V5-tagged PDI or empty vector. Subcellular localisation, XBP-1 and CHOP activation, proteasome reporter (GFPu) accumulation, nuclear morphology, and cleaved caspase-3 immunoreactivity were assessed by confocal microscopy. Transient transgenic zebrafish larvae generated by mRNA co-injection of cyclin F and PDI were assessed by photomotor response at 48 h post-fertilisation. Mutant cyclin F S621G induced cytoplasmic mislocalisation, ER stress (assessed by XBP-1 and CHOP activation), proteasome dysfunction (indicated by GFPu accumulation), and apoptosis (assessed by nuclear condensation and caspase-3 activation), all of which were significantly attenuated by PDI co-expression. Zebrafish larvae expressing cyclin F S621G swam significantly shorter distances than uninjected or wildtype controls, and co-expression of PDI restored motor function to near-wildtype levels. PDI protects against ALS/FTD-associated mutant cyclin F in both cellular and in vivo zebrafish models, identifying PDI as a redox-based therapeutic target for CCNF -linked ALS/FTD.
items.titleZh: 蛋白质二硫键异构酶在斑马鱼和细胞模型中保护免受与细胞周期蛋白F相关的ALS/FTD表型
items.summaryZh: 该研究在Neuro-2a细胞和斑马鱼模型中测试了蛋白质二硫键异构酶（PDI）对ALS/FTD相关细胞周期蛋白F S621G突变的保护作用。结果显示，PDI共表达可显著减轻突变型细胞周期蛋白F引起的细胞质错误定位、内质网应激、蛋白酶体功能障碍和凋亡，并改善斑马鱼幼鱼的游动缺陷。研究提示PDI是CCNF相关ALS/FTD的潜在治疗靶点，但证据仅来自细胞和动物模型。
items.insight: CCNF突变是ALS/FTD中较少被研究的遗传亚型，本研究首次在细胞和斑马鱼模型中验证PDI对突变型细胞周期蛋白F的保护作用，为这一亚型提供了可操作的氧化还原相关靶点，值得关注后续是否能推进到更接近人类的模型或临床前开发。

aiRead.studyType: 细胞与斑马鱼模型的机制/干预研究
aiRead.keyFinding: PDI过表达可减轻突变型细胞周期蛋白F S621G诱导的细胞质错误定位、内质网应激、蛋白酶体功能障碍和凋亡，并改善斑马鱼幼鱼运动功能。
aiRead.limitation: 证据仅来自Neuro-2a细胞和瞬时转基因斑马鱼模型，尚未在哺乳动物模型或患者中验证，不能推断临床疗效。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注PDI在CCNF相关ALS/FTD哺乳动物模型中的验证，以及靶向PDI的氧化还原调节策略是否进入临床前开发。

items.abstractZh: 编码细胞周期蛋白F的CCNF基因突变导致一小部分肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）和额颞叶痴呆（FTD）病例。突变型细胞周期蛋白F从细胞核错误定位至细胞质，损害泛素蛋白酶体系统，破坏内质网（ER）至高尔基体运输，并触发内质网应激和凋亡。蛋白质二硫键异构酶（PDI）是硫氧还蛋白超家族中一种具有氧化还原活性的内质网伴侣蛋白，可保护免受突变型SOD1、TDP-43和FUS诱导的ALS表型，但其对突变型细胞周期蛋白F的活性尚未被研究。为检验PDI过表达是否能预防ALS/FTD相关细胞周期蛋白F S621G突变诱导的细胞和行为表型。将Neuro-2a细胞与mCherry标记的野生型或突变型细胞周期蛋白F S621G以及V5标记的PDI或空载体共转染。通过共聚焦显微镜评估亚细胞定位、XBP-1和CHOP激活、蛋白酶体报告基因（GFPu）积累、核形态和切割型caspase-3免疫反应性。通过受精后48小时的光运动反应评估由细胞周期蛋白F和PDI mRNA共注射产生的瞬时转基因斑马鱼幼鱼。突变型细胞周期蛋白F S621G诱导细胞质错误定位、内质网应激（通过XBP-1和CHOP激活评估）、蛋白酶体功能障碍（通过GFPu积累指示）和凋亡（通过核浓缩和caspase-3激活评估），所有这些均被PDI共表达显著减弱。表达细胞周期蛋白F S621G的斑马鱼幼鱼游动距离显著短于未注射或野生型对照，而PDI共表达将运动功能恢复至接近野生型水平。PDI在细胞和体内斑马鱼模型中均保护免受ALS/FTD相关突变型细胞周期蛋白F的影响，将PDI确定为CCNF相关ALS/FTD的基于氧化还原的治疗靶点。
items.frontierRationale: 新近研究首次在细胞和斑马鱼模型中揭示PDI对CCNF相关ALS/FTD突变型细胞周期蛋白F的保护作用，具有转化研究价值。

items.title: Nanopore sequencing combined with adaptive sampling and NanoExpansion enables accurate characterization of repeat expansion disorders.
items.summary: Expansion repeat disorders are caused by abnormal expansions of short tandem repeats (STRs). We evaluated targeted long-read nanopore sequencing for comprehensive characterization of STR expansions in 132 participants, including patients with myotonic dystrophy type 1 (DM1, n = 51) and DM2 ( n = 3) already characterized by Southern blot, C9orf72 -associated amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS n = 11) evaluated by repeat primed polymerase chain reaction (RP-PCR; validation group), suspected spinocerebellar ataxia (SCA, n = 46), cerebellar ataxia with neuropathy and vestibular areflexia syndrome (CANVAS; n = 13), Huntington's disease (1), Kennedy disease (1), Friedreich ataxia (FRDA, 2), and 4 healthy controls (test group). Native DNA was sequenced using adaptive sampling (AS) on Oxford Nanopore GridION or PromethION-2Solo platforms. Long-PCR sequencing was performed for comparison. We also developed NanoExpansion, a Python-based tool for sizing expanded alleles and detecting sequence interruptions. We correctly characterized all DM1, DM2, ALS, FRDA, Huntington's disease, and Kennedy disease cases, and identified eight SCA27B, two SCA37, three SCA31, one SCA3, and nine CANVAS cases. Compared with the AS approach, long-PCR underestimated alleles exceeding 800 repeats. Repeat interruptions were detected in 27/51 (52.9%) DM1 cases and 1/10 (10%) ALS, but not in CANVAS, FRDA, Huntington's disease, Kennedy disease, or SCA cases. This integrated sequencing analysis pipeline provides accurate, comprehensive characterization of repeat expansion disorders and has the potential to improve routine genetic diagnosis.
items.evidenceLevel: 观察性临床研究（方法学验证，含验证组与测试组）
items.titleZh: 纳米孔测序结合自适应采样与NanoExpansion可实现对重复扩增疾病的准确表征
items.summaryZh: 该研究在132名参与者中评估了靶向长读长纳米孔测序（结合自适应采样）对多种短串联重复扩增疾病的检测能力，并开发了NanoExpansion分析工具。研究覆盖DM1、DM2、C9orf72相关ALS、SCA、CANVAS、亨廷顿病、肯尼迪病和FRDA等病种。结果显示该方法能正确表征所有DM1、DM2、ALS、FRDA、亨廷顿病和肯尼迪病病例，并识别出多例SCA和CANVAS；长PCR会低估超长扩增等位基因，而纳米孔测序还能检测重复序列中断。作者认为该流程有望用于常规遗传诊断。
items.insight: C9orf72六核苷酸重复扩增是ALS最重要的遗传病因之一，但其准确分型（扩增长度、序列中断、甲基化等）在常规检测中仍具挑战。该研究将自适应采样纳米孔测序与专用分析工具结合，在包括11例C9orf72-ALS的样本中实现重复扩增的全面表征，并提示长PCR对超长等位基因存在低估。对ALS研究者而言，这提供了一条可同时获取扩增长度与序列结构的单平台技术路径，值得关注其在更大ALS队列及临床诊断场景中的验证进展。

aiRead.studyType: 方法学验证研究：在132名参与者中评估靶向长读长纳米孔测序（自适应采样）联合NanoExpansion工具对短串联重复扩增疾病的表征能力，并与长PCR比较。
aiRead.keyFinding: 该方法正确表征了所有DM1、DM2、ALS、FRDA、亨廷顿病和肯尼迪病病例，并识别出多例SCA和CANVAS；长PCR低估超过800个重复的等位基因；在52.9%的DM1和10%的ALS病例中检测到重复中断。
aiRead.limitation: 样本量有限，ALS验证组仅11例且为已用RP-PCR评估的C9orf72相关病例；研究为方法学验证而非诊断效能的前瞻性对照研究，尚未在常规临床流程中验证。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注该流程在更大规模C9orf72-ALS队列中的验证、与其他重复扩增检测方法（如RP-PCR、Southern blot）的系统比较，以及NanoExpansion工具的临床可及性与标准化进展。

items.abstractZh: 重复扩增疾病由短串联重复序列（STR）的异常扩增引起。我们评估了靶向长读长纳米孔测序在132名参与者中对STR扩增进行全面表征的能力，包括已通过Southern blot确诊的强直性肌营养不良1型（DM1，n=51）和2型（DM2，n=3）患者、通过重复引物PCR（RP-PCR）评估的C9orf72相关肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS，n=11；验证组）、疑似脊髓小脑共济失调（SCA，n=46）、小脑性共济失调伴神经病和前庭反射消失综合征（CANVAS；n=13）、亨廷顿病（1例）、肯尼迪病（1例）、弗里德赖希共济失调（FRDA，2例）以及4名健康对照（测试组）。使用Oxford Nanopore GridION或PromethION-2Solo平台对天然DNA进行自适应采样（AS）测序。同时进行长PCR测序以作比较。我们还开发了NanoExpansion，一个基于Python的工具，用于确定扩增等位基因的大小并检测序列中断。我们正确表征了所有DM1、DM2、ALS、FRDA、亨廷顿病和肯尼迪病病例，并识别出8例SCA27B、2例SCA37、3例SCA31、1例SCA3和9例CANVAS病例。与AS方法相比，长PCR低估了超过800个重复的等位基因。在27/51（52.9%）的DM1病例和1/10（10%）的ALS病例中检测到重复中断，但在CANVAS、FRDA、亨廷顿病、肯尼迪病或SCA病例中未检测到。该整合测序分析流程可对重复扩增疾病进行准确、全面的表征，并有望改善常规遗传诊断。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究将自适应采样长读长纳米孔测序与专用分析工具整合，新近展示了在包括C9orf72-ALS在内的重复扩增疾病中实现扩增长度与序列中断全面表征的转化潜力。

items.title: Acidic cannabinoids in brain disorders: Neurobiological mechanisms, preclinical evidence, and translational challenges.
items.summary: Acidic cannabinoids, including tetrahydrocannabinolic acid (THCA), cannabidiolic acid (CBDA), cannabigerolic acid (CBGA), and related biosynthetic precursors, represent the predominant phytocannabinoid forms naturally produced by Cannabis sativa. Long considered pharmacologically inactive intermediates, these compounds are now increasingly recognized as bioactive molecules with potential therapeutic relevance for brain disorders. Compared with their decarboxylated counterparts, acidic cannabinoids exhibit distinct physicochemical, pharmacokinetic, and pharmacodynamic properties that may confer reduced psychotropic liability together with unique neurobiological effects. Emerging preclinical evidence indicates that acidic cannabinoids modulate multiple processes implicated in neurological and psychiatric disorders, including serotonergic and endocannabinoid signaling, neuroinflammation, oxidative stress, mitochondrial dysfunction, calcium dyshomeostasis, and synaptic transmission. In this review, we critically examine current knowledge regarding acidic cannabinoids in the context of brain disorders. We first summarize their biosynthesis, chemical stability, pharmacokinetic characteristics, and pharmacological differences from neutral cannabinoids. We then examine preclinical evidence supporting their potential therapeutic effects in epilepsy, anxiety, depression, psychosis-related conditions, and neurodegenerative diseases, including Alzheimer's disease, Parkinson's disease, Huntington's disease, and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis. We also discuss how artificial intelligence and computational approaches may support target identification, formulation optimization, pharmacokinetic modeling, and the development of personalized cannabinoid-based interventions. Finally, we highlight key methodological and translational challenges limiting the field and outline priorities for future research. Overall, acidic cannabinoids emerge as promising but still underexplored multitarget compounds with potential relevance for the treatment of brain disorders.
items.evidenceLevel: 综述/荟萃分析（叙述性综述，临床前证据为主）
items.titleZh: 酸性大麻素类化合物在脑部疾病中的作用：神经生物学机制、临床前证据与转化挑战
items.summaryZh: 这是一篇综述，系统梳理酸性大麻素（THCA、CBDA、CBGA等）的生物学特性与脑部疾病临床前证据。文章指出这类化合物并非无活性中间体，而具有多靶点神经生物学作用，涉及5-羟色胺与内源性大麻素信号、神经炎症、氧化应激、线粒体功能、钙稳态和突触传递。文中覆盖癫痫、焦虑、抑郁、精神病相关状况及阿尔茨海默病、帕金森病、亨廷顿病和ALS等神经退行性疾病的临床前证据，并讨论AI在靶点识别、制剂优化和药代建模中的潜在作用，同时强调方法学与转化挑战。
items.insight: ALS领域长期缺乏能同时干预神经炎症、线粒体功能障碍和兴奋性毒性的多靶点候选分子；该综述将酸性大麻素列为尚未充分开发的多靶点化合物，并明确把ALS纳入神经退行性疾病证据框架，为研究者提供了新的候选机制方向和需要验证的转化问题（如稳定性、药代、精神活性风险）。

aiRead.studyType: 叙述性综述（非系统综述/荟萃分析），汇总临床前与机制研究
aiRead.keyFinding: 酸性大麻素并非无活性中间体，而是可调节神经炎症、氧化应激、线粒体功能、钙稳态及突触传递的多靶点生物活性分子，临床前证据支持其在包括ALS在内的神经退行性疾病中的潜在相关性。
aiRead.limitation: 证据主要来自临床前研究，缺乏临床疗效数据；酸性大麻素的化学稳定性、药代动力学、标准化和质量控制仍是转化障碍；综述本身未提供新的原始实验数据。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注后续针对酸性大麻素在ALS模型中的靶点验证、制剂与药代优化研究，以及是否进入早期临床试验；同时留意AI辅助靶点识别和个性化大麻素干预的进展。

items.abstractZh: 酸性大麻素类化合物，包括四氢大麻酚酸（THCA）、大麻二酚酸（CBDA）、大麻萜酚酸（CBGA）及相关生物合成前体，是Cannabis sativa天然产生的主要植物大麻素形式。这些化合物长期被视为药理学上无活性的中间体，如今日益被认为是对脑部疾病具有潜在治疗相关性的生物活性分子。与其脱羧对应物相比，酸性大麻素类化合物具有独特的理化、药代动力学和药效学特性，可能赋予其较低的精神活性倾向以及独特的神经生物学效应。新出现的临床前证据表明，酸性大麻素类化合物可调节与神经和精神疾病相关的多种过程，包括5-羟色胺能信号传导、内源性大麻素信号传导、神经炎症、氧化应激、线粒体功能障碍、钙稳态失衡以及突触传递。在本综述中，我们批判性地审视了酸性大麻素类化合物在脑部疾病背景下的当前知识。我们首先总结其生物合成、化学稳定性、药代动力学特征以及与中性大麻素的药理学差异。随后，我们审视支持其在癫痫、焦虑、抑郁、精神病相关状况以及神经退行性疾病（包括阿尔茨海默病、帕金森病、亨廷顿病和肌萎缩侧索硬化）中潜在治疗效果的临床前证据。我们还讨论了人工智能和计算方法如何支持靶点识别、制剂优化、药代动力学建模以及个性化大麻素干预措施的开发。最后，我们强调了限制该领域的关键方法学和转化挑战，并概述了未来研究的优先事项。总体而言，酸性大麻素类化合物作为有前景但仍未被充分探索的多靶点化合物出现，对脑部疾病的治疗具有潜在相关性。
items.frontierRationale: 该综述新近系统整合了酸性大麻素这一被低估的多靶点化合物在ALS等神经退行性疾病中的临床前证据与转化挑战，具有明确的ALS相关性和转化研究价值。

items.title: OGT regulates RNA-binding protein nucleocytoplasmic partitioning, but this fails in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis.
items.summary: O-linked N-acetylglucosamine transferase (OGT) catalyzes the O-linked β-N-acetylglucosamine (O-GlcNAc) modification to proteins and has been implicated in a range of diseases, including amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS), a rapidly progressive and currently incurable neurodegenerative disorder. However, the precise mechanisms by which OGT influences ALS pathogenesis remain largely unresolved. In this study, we used human-induced pluripotent stem cell (hiPSC)-derived spinal motor neurons (hiPSC-MNs), the principal cell type that undergoes degeneration in ALS, to systematically reveal that OGT-related mechanisms regulate RNA-binding protein (RBP) nucleocytoplasmic compartmentalization. Using a combination of antisense oligonucleotide (ASO) technology and small molecular pharmacology, we reveal two distinct regulatory mechanisms of RBP compartmentalization, including by intron-retaining transcript-mediated sequestration and O-linked N-acetylglucosaminylation (O-GlcNAcylation)-mediated nuclear transport. We finally examine the tractability of manipulating OGT activity in the ALS context but demonstrate that the OGT-related mechanisms governing RBP localization in healthy hiPSC-MNs are impaired in the context of ALS-causing VCP and TARDBP mutations.
items.titleZh: OGT调控RNA结合蛋白的核质分配，但在肌萎缩侧索硬化中这一机制失效
items.summaryZh: 该研究利用人诱导多能干细胞来源的脊髓运动神经元，发现OGT通过两种机制调控RNA结合蛋白在细胞核与细胞质之间的分布：内含子保留转录本的隔离作用和O-GlcNAc修饰介导的核转运。在携带ALS致病突变VCP和TARDBP的细胞中，这些调控机制出现障碍，提示OGT相关通路在ALS运动神经元中功能受损。
items.insight: 该研究将OGT介导的O-GlcNAc修饰与RNA结合蛋白核质定位障碍联系起来，为理解ALS中TDP-43等RBP异常聚集/错位提供了新的细胞模型和机制线索；同时提示在ALS背景下直接操纵OGT活性可能面临通路已受损的挑战，值得关注后续能否找到绕过该障碍的干预节点。

aiRead.studyType: 细胞实验（hiPSC来源脊髓运动神经元，结合ASO和小分子药理学）
aiRead.keyFinding: OGT相关机制通过内含子保留转录本隔离和O-GlcNAc修饰介导的核转运调控RBP核质区室化，而该机制在VCP和TARDBP突变背景下受损。
aiRead.limitation: 研究基于体外hiPSC运动神经元模型，尚不能反映完整体内环境及疾病全程；操纵OGT活性在ALS背景下未能有效恢复RBP定位。
aiRead.watchNext: 后续是否能在ALS模型中绕过受损的OGT通路恢复RBP核质平衡，以及该机制在更多ALS遗传背景和体内模型中的验证。

items.abstractZh: O-连接的N-乙酰葡糖胺转移酶（OGT）催化蛋白质的O-连接β-N-乙酰葡糖胺（O-GlcNAc）修饰，并已被认为与多种疾病相关，包括肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）——一种快速进展且目前无法治愈的神经退行性疾病。然而，OGT影响ALS发病机制的确切机制在很大程度上仍未阐明。在本研究中，我们使用人诱导多能干细胞（hiPSC）来源的脊髓运动神经元（hiPSC-MNs）——ALS中发生变性的主要细胞类型——系统性地揭示了OGT相关机制调控RNA结合蛋白（RBP）的核质区室化。通过结合反义寡核苷酸（ASO）技术和小分子药理学，我们揭示了RBP区室化的两种不同调控机制，包括内含子保留转录本介导的隔离和O-连接N-乙酰葡糖胺化（O-GlcNAcylation）介导的核转运。我们最后检验了在ALS背景下操纵OGT活性的可操作性，但证明在健康hiPSC-MNs中支配RBP定位的OGT相关机制在ALS致病性VCP和TARDBP突变背景下受损。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究于2026年发表，利用hiPSC来源的ALS运动神经元揭示OGT调控RBP核质分配的机制在致病突变下失效，具有明确的ALS机制相关性。

items.title: Global epidemiological and genetic burden of rare neurological diseases in children.
items.summary: We assessed the global burden of rare childhood neurological diseases from 1990 to 2021 and projected trends to 2050 using Global Burden of Disease data, alongside an analysis of the genetic burden from ClinVar. Four neurological conditions were classified as rare childhood neurological diseases: motor neuron disease, multiple sclerosis, neuroblastoma and other peripheral nervous cell tumors, and other neurological disorders. From 1990 to 2021, the global age-standardized prevalence and disability-adjusted life-year rates of rare childhood neurological diseases increased, with higher burdens among boys and in low-middle sociodemographic index countries. Our customized forecasting model projected that 110.2 thousand children would be affected by 2050, representing an 11.83% increase from 2021. Annual and cumulative increases in newly reported disease-causing genes and pathogenic/likely pathogenic variants associated with monogenic neurological diseases were observed from 1990 to 2024. The increasing and disparate burden of rare childhood neurological diseases highlights the need for targeted prevention.
items.evidenceLevel: 流行病学建模与数据库分析（GBD数据+ClinVar），非临床或机制实验
items.titleZh: 全球儿童罕见神经系统疾病的流行病学与遗传负担
items.summaryZh: 该研究基于全球疾病负担数据，分析1990—2021年儿童罕见神经系统疾病（含运动神经元病）的患病与伤残负担，并预测至2050年受累儿童将达约11.02万，较2021年增加约11.8%。负担在男孩和中低社会人口指数国家更高。同时，ClinVar数据显示单基因神经系统疾病的致病基因和致病变异报告数量持续累积增加。作者强调需要针对性预防。
items.insight: 运动神经元病被纳入儿童罕见神经系统疾病范畴，提示ALS相关疾病负担在儿童人群中同样值得关注；研究同时量化了单基因致病基因与变异的持续增长，为ALS遗传筛查和早发人群的病因学布局提供流行病学背景。

items.abstractZh: 我们利用全球疾病负担数据评估了1990年至2021年全球儿童罕见神经系统疾病的负担，并预测了至2050年的趋势，同时结合ClinVar数据分析了遗传负担。四种神经系统疾病被归类为儿童罕见神经系统疾病：运动神经元病、多发性硬化、神经母细胞瘤及其他外周神经细胞肿瘤，以及其他神经系统疾病。1990年至2021年间，全球儿童罕见神经系统疾病的年龄标化患病率和伤残调整生命年率均上升，男孩及中低社会人口指数国家的负担更高。我们的定制预测模型预计，到2050年将有11.02万名儿童受累，较2021年增加11.83%。1990年至2024年间，与单基因神经系统疾病相关的新报告致病基因及致病/可能致病变异的年度和累计数量均有所增加。儿童罕见神经系统疾病负担不断上升且存在差异，凸显了开展针对性预防的必要性。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究以最新GBD数据和ClinVar变异累积分析，前瞻预测至2050年儿童罕见神经系统疾病（含运动神经元病）负担，具有新近性与公共卫生转化价值。

items.title: The Role of Astrocytes in the Inflammatory Response in Neurodiseases.
items.summary: Astrocytes have emerged as central regulators of neuroinflammation, extending far beyond their traditional roles as structural and metabolic support cells. In neurological disorders, astrocytes undergo reactive remodeling that encompasses morphological, transcriptional, metabolic, and functional changes. Rather than fitting into a fixed A1/A2 dichotomy, reactive astrocytes exist along a disease-, region-, and stage-dependent continuum shaped by local pathology and intercellular crosstalk. This review summarizes how astrocytes contribute to neuroinflammatory processes in Alzheimer's disease, Parkinson's disease, amyotrophic lateral sclerosis, Huntington's disease, central nervous system injury, infection, multiple sclerosis, epilepsy, and autism spectrum disorder. We highlight convergent mechanisms, including cytokine and chemokine release, complement activation, glutamate and ion homeostasis disruption, oxidative stress, metabolic reprogramming, and blood-brain barrier regulation, while emphasizing disease-specific astrocytic programs. We further discuss astrocyte interactions with microglia, neurons, oligodendrocytes, endothelial cells, and peripheral immune cells, as well as key regulatory pathways, epigenetic remodeling, and lipid-dependent metabolic signaling. Finally, we evaluate current and emerging astrocyte-targeted therapeutic strategies, including metabolic modulation, receptor targeting, gene editing, nanodelivery, and gut-brain axis interventions. Defining functionally validated astrocyte states and developing biomarker-guided, stage-adaptive therapies may enable more precise intervention in neuroinflammatory and neurodegenerative diseases.
items.titleZh: 星形胶质细胞在神经疾病炎症反应中的作用
items.summaryZh: 这篇综述系统梳理了星形胶质细胞在多种神经疾病（包括ALS）神经炎症中的核心作用，强调反应性星形胶质细胞并非简单的A1/A2二分，而是随疾病、脑区和阶段变化的连续状态。文章归纳了细胞因子释放、补体激活、谷氨酸与离子稳态失衡、氧化应激、代谢重编程和血脑屏障调控等共同机制，并讨论了星形胶质细胞与小胶质细胞、神经元、少突胶质细胞、内皮细胞及外周免疫细胞的交互。治疗方面，综述评估了代谢调节、受体靶向、基因编辑、纳米递送和肠-脑轴干预等星形胶质细胞靶向策略，提出以生物标志物引导、阶段适应性治疗实现更精准干预的方向。
items.insight: ALS领域长期聚焦运动神经元和小胶质细胞，而星形胶质细胞在疾病不同阶段的功能异质性正成为重要突破口。该综述将ALS纳入跨疾病比较框架，有助于识别星形胶质细胞反应状态的可转化靶点，并为生物标志物分层和阶段适应性治疗设计提供思路，值得关注神经炎症机制和转化研究的ALS研究者跟踪。

aiRead.keyFinding: 星形胶质细胞以疾病、区域和阶段依赖的连续状态参与神经炎症，而非固定A1/A2二分；多种汇聚机制和交互网络构成潜在治疗靶点。
aiRead.limitation: 为综述性总结，未提供原始实验数据或临床疗效验证；所述星形胶质细胞状态定义和治疗策略多处于临床前或概念阶段。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注功能验证的星形胶质细胞状态分类、ALS特异性星形胶质细胞程序，以及生物标志物引导的阶段适应性治疗能否进入临床转化研究。

items.abstractZh: 星形胶质细胞已成为神经炎症的核心调节者，其作用远超传统认为的结构和代谢支持细胞角色。在神经系统疾病中，星形胶质细胞经历反应性重塑，涵盖形态学、转录、代谢和功能变化。反应性星形胶质细胞并非符合固定的A1/A2二分法，而是存在于由局部病理和细胞间交互作用塑造的、疾病特异性、区域特异性和阶段依赖性的连续谱中。本综述总结了星形胶质细胞如何在阿尔茨海默病、帕金森病、肌萎缩侧索硬化、亨廷顿病、中枢神经系统损伤、感染、多发性硬化、癫痫和自闭症谱系障碍中参与神经炎症过程。我们重点介绍了汇聚性机制，包括细胞因子和趋化因子释放、补体激活、谷氨酸和离子稳态破坏、氧化应激、代谢重编程和血脑屏障调节，同时强调疾病特异性的星形胶质细胞程序。我们进一步讨论了星形胶质细胞与小胶质细胞、神经元、少突胶质细胞、内皮细胞和外周免疫细胞的相互作用，以及关键调控通路、表观遗传重塑和脂质依赖性代谢信号。最后，我们评估了当前和新兴的星形胶质细胞靶向治疗策略，包括代谢调节、受体靶向、基因编辑、纳米递送和肠-脑轴干预。定义功能上经过验证的星形胶质细胞状态并开发生物标志物引导的、阶段适应性疗法，可能有助于对神经炎症和神经退行性疾病进行更精确的干预。
items.frontierRationale: 该综述于2026年发表，系统整合了星形胶质细胞反应状态连续谱及代谢、表观遗传和纳米递送等新兴靶向策略，与ALS神经炎症机制和转化治疗直接相关。

items.title: Tyrosine nitration: An emerging mechanistic landscape in neurodegeneration and cardiopulmonary disease.
items.summary: Protein tyrosine nitration is a post-translational modification associated with conditions of oxidative and inflammatory stress, driven by the production of reactive oxygen and nitrogen species (ROS and RNS). Once considered primarily a footprint of oxidative damage, tyrosine nitration is increasingly recognized as a selective modification that, in specific biological contexts, can alter protein structure, stability, enzymatic activity, and interaction networks. Mechanistically, nitration occurs through peroxynitrite-dependent and heme-peroxidase-dependent pathways and preferentially targets specific tyrosine residues based on local protein structure, solvent accessibility, and microenvironmental chemistry. Accumulating evidence has identified disease-specific nitration signatures across multiple pathological contexts. In neurodegenerative disorders, including Alzheimer's disease, Parkinson's disease, and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis, nitration of proteins such as tau, α-synuclein, manganese superoxide dismutase, ATP synthase, glyceraldehyde-3-phosphate dehydrogenase, heat shock proteins, and cytoskeletal components contributes to mitochondrial dysfunction, protein aggregation, metabolic failure, and neuronal loss. Similarly, in cardiovascular and pulmonary diseases, protein tyrosine nitration disrupts vascular and epithelial homeostasis by impairing endothelial signaling, fibrinolysis, lipid metabolism, and barrier integrity through modification of key regulatory proteins. By influencing phosphorylation-dependent signaling, enzymatic function, and protein-protein interactions, tyrosine nitration contributes to the connection between redox imbalance and progressive cellular and tissue dysfunction. This review summarizes current mechanistic insights into site-specific protein tyrosine nitration, highlights the emerging disease-associated nitroproteome, and discusses how advances in analytical and structural approaches are redefining nitration as a functional regulatory modification. Understanding the molecular determinants and consequences of tyrosine nitration may enable the development of targeted diagnostics and therapeutic strategies across diverse human diseases.

items.titleZh: 酪氨酸硝化：神经退行性疾病与心肺疾病中新兴的机制图景
items.summaryZh: 这篇综述指出，蛋白质酪氨酸硝化不只是氧化损伤的“痕迹”，而是一种可选择性改变蛋白结构、酶活性和相互作用网络的翻译后修饰。文章梳理了过氧亚硝酸盐依赖和血红素过氧化物酶依赖两条主要硝化途径，并总结神经退行性疾病（含ALS）中tau、α-突触核蛋白、MnSOD、ATP合酶、GAPDH、热休克蛋白及细胞骨架蛋白的硝化与线粒体功能障碍、蛋白聚集和神经元丢失相关；心肺疾病中硝化则影响内皮信号、纤溶、脂代谢和屏障完整性。作者强调分析技术进步正在推动“硝基蛋白质组”作为疾病相关修饰谱的认知，但本文为综述，不提供新的临床疗效证据。
items.insight: 对ALS研究者而言，价值在于把“氧化应激”从笼统背景变量拆解为可定位、可定量的位点特异性硝化事件：MnSOD、ATP合酶等线粒体相关蛋白的硝化直接连接能量代谢失败，而硝基蛋白质组有潜力成为区分ALS与其他神经退行性疾病的机制性标志物候选。综述同时提示，硝化与磷酸化信号存在交互，未来设计抗氧化或线粒体靶向试验时，应把硝化位点作为药效学和患者分层指标纳入考量。

aiRead.keyFinding: 酪氨酸硝化通过过氧亚硝酸盐和血红素过氧化物酶途径选择性修饰特定蛋白位点，在ALS等神经退行性疾病中与线粒体功能障碍、蛋白聚集和神经元丢失相关，并形成疾病相关硝基蛋白质组特征

items.abstractZh: 蛋白质酪氨酸硝化是一种与氧化应激和炎症应激状态相关的翻译后修饰，由活性氧和活性氮（ROS和RNS）的产生驱动。它曾主要被视为氧化损伤的痕迹，如今日益被认为是一种选择性修饰，在特定生物学背景中可改变蛋白质结构、稳定性、酶活性和相互作用网络。在机制上，硝化通过过氧亚硝酸盐依赖性和血红素过氧化物酶依赖性途径发生，并依据局部蛋白质结构、溶剂可及性和微环境化学性质优先靶向特定酪氨酸残基。不断积累的证据已在多种病理背景中鉴定出疾病特异性的硝化特征谱。在神经退行性疾病中，包括阿尔茨海默病、帕金森病和肌萎缩侧索硬化，tau、α-突触核蛋白、锰超氧化物歧化酶、ATP合酶、甘油醛-3-磷酸脱氢酶、热休克蛋白和细胞骨架组分等蛋白质的硝化，促成线粒体功能障碍、蛋白质聚集、代谢衰竭和神经元丢失。同样，在心血管和肺部疾病中，蛋白质酪氨酸硝化通过修饰关键调控蛋白，损害内皮信号传导、纤维蛋白溶解、脂质代谢和屏障完整性，从而破坏血管和上皮稳态。通过影响磷酸化依赖性信号传导、酶功能和蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用，酪氨酸硝化促成了氧化还原失衡与进行性细胞和组织功能障碍之间的联系。本综述总结了当前关于位点特异性蛋白质酪氨酸硝化的机制认识，重点介绍了新兴的疾病相关硝基蛋白质组，并讨论了分析和结构方法的进展如何重新定义硝化作为一种功能性调控修饰。理解酪氨酸硝化的分子决定因素和后果，可能有助于在多种人类疾病中开发靶向诊断和治疗策略。
items.frontierRationale: 该综述于2026年整合位点特异性硝化与新兴硝基蛋白质组，将酪氨酸硝化从氧化损伤标志重新定位为ALS等神经退行性疾病中可干预的功能性调控修饰，具有机制转化价值。

items.title: TDP-43 and ALS - what's wrong with my membranes?
items.summary: In recent years, multiple pathologies of the mRNA binding protein TDP-43 have been linked to the neurodegenerative disease Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis (ALS), in which almost 97% of all ALS patients exhibit TDP-43 abnormalities in affected neurons. Typically, neuronal degeneration first affects alpha motor neurons of the spinal cord and the lower brainstem, before the disease progresses to Betz cells, giant neurons of the primary motor cortex, and subsequently spreads into further brain regions. It is just the Betz cells though, which do not show cytosolic TDP-43 aggregation upon loss of nuclear TDP-43 expression, but instead display membrane defects in organelles such as the Golgi apparatus, the ER and the nuclear envelope. In this review, we will therefore examine connections between TDP-43 and inner membrane systems, with a particular focus on nuclear and the ER membranes. In doing so, we will summarize evidence suggesting that the disease may have an early onset, potentially even prenatally, and describe how interactions between TDP-43 and the lipid metabolism as well as connections with membrane components, may drive cells towards ALS as time goes by.
items.titleZh: TDP-43与ALS——我的膜出了什么问题？
items.summaryZh: 这篇综述聚焦TDP-43与细胞内膜系统（尤其是核膜和内质网膜）的关联，指出ALS中Betz细胞不形成TDP-43胞质聚集，而是出现高尔基体、内质网和核膜缺陷；作者提出疾病可能起源极早（甚至产前），TDP-43与脂质代谢及膜组分的相互作用可能随时间推动ALS发生。
items.insight: 该综述提出ALS可能具有产前起源的假说，并将TDP-43病理与内膜系统及脂质代谢联系起来，为理解ALS早期机制和Betz细胞选择性易损性提供了新视角，值得关注后续功能验证研究。

aiRead.keyFinding: Betz细胞在核内TDP-43缺失时不形成胞质聚集，而表现为高尔基体、内质网和核膜缺陷；TDP-43与脂质代谢及膜组分的相互作用可能驱动ALS进展，疾病起源可能极早甚至产前。

items.abstractZh: 近年来，mRNA结合蛋白TDP-43的多种病理改变已被与神经退行性疾病肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）联系起来，几乎所有ALS患者（97%）的受累神经元中都表现出TDP-43异常。通常，神经元变性首先影响脊髓和低位脑干的α运动神经元，随后疾病进展至初级运动皮层的巨型神经元Betz细胞，并进一步扩散到其他脑区。然而，恰恰是Betz细胞在核内TDP-43表达缺失时并不表现出胞质TDP-43聚集，而是显示出高尔基体、内质网和核膜等细胞器的膜缺陷。因此，本综述将探讨TDP-43与内膜系统之间的联系，特别关注核膜和内质网膜。在此过程中，我们将总结提示该疾病可能具有早期起源（甚至可能产前起源）的证据，并描述TDP-43与脂质代谢的相互作用以及与膜组分的联系如何随时间推移驱动细胞走向ALS。
items.frontierRationale: 该综述新近提出ALS可能产前起源的假说，并将TDP-43与内膜系统及脂质代谢关联，对理解ALS早期机制具有潜在转化价值。

items.title: Polyamines across neurodegenerative proteinopathies.
items.summary: Polyamines (PAs) are evolutionarily conserved metabolites that connect protein quality control with lysosomal, mitochondrial, and redox homeostasis. Their metabolism is situated at a critical intersection of cell-sustaining and neurodegenerative pathways. Here, we synthesize evidence across Alzheimer's disease, Parkinson's disease, polyglutamine repeat disorders, amyotrophic lateral sclerosis, and multiple system atrophy, each of which differs in vulnerability to changes in PA metabolism. Although previous reviews have investigated PAs in individual neurodegenerative disorders, few have compared their roles across the broader spectrum of neurodegenerative proteinopathies. We address this gap by synthesizing evidence across multiple diseases to examine how PAs influence disease-associated protein aggregation and clearance, and how these effects depend on PA species, concentration, cellular context, disease stage, subcellular localization, redox state, and lysosomal and mitochondrial capacity. Human tissue and biofluid studies report disease-associated changes in PA metabolites, pathway enzymes, and transporter remodeling, as a function of neurodegenerative disorders. Mechanistic studies reveal that spermidine and spermine can alter the assembly, condensation, compartmentalization, and clearance of various neurotoxic proteins, whereas the effects of putrescine are more system- and concentration-dependent. These effects engage both shared pathways and distinct mechanisms, depending on protein identity, cell type, and subcellular location. Curiously, PA manipulation may be protective in one context yet harmful in another. The framework that we propose can distinguish adaptive remodeling from pathogenic dysregulation and can guide disease-relevant therapeutic strategies.
items.titleZh: 多胺在神经退行性蛋白病中的作用
items.summaryZh: 该综述系统比较了多胺代谢在阿尔茨海默病、帕金森病、多聚谷氨酰胺病、ALS和多系统萎缩等神经退行性蛋白病中的角色。作者指出，多胺（尤其是亚精胺和精胺）可影响神经毒性蛋白的聚集、凝聚和清除，但效应高度依赖多胺种类、浓度、细胞环境和疾病阶段；腐胺的作用更依赖系统与浓度。人类组织和体液研究显示多胺代谢物、通路酶和转运体随疾病发生改变。综述强调多胺干预可能在不同情境下具有保护或有害双重作用，并提出区分适应性重塑与致病性失调的框架。
items.insight: ALS研究者应关注该综述提出的多胺作用框架：多胺代谢与蛋白稳态、线粒体和溶酶体功能交叉，而这些都是ALS核心病理环节。综述提示亚精胺/精胺对蛋白聚集和清除的调节具有环境依赖性，未来研究需在ALS模型和患者样本中明确多胺改变是代偿性还是致病性，并据此判断多胺相关干预的转化方向。

items.abstractZh: 多胺（PAs）是进化上保守的代谢物，将蛋白质质量控制与溶酶体、线粒体和氧化还原稳态联系起来。其代谢处于细胞维持与神经退行性通路的关键交汇点。本文综合了阿尔茨海默病、帕金森病、多聚谷氨酰胺重复序列疾病、肌萎缩侧索硬化症和多系统萎缩的证据，这些疾病对多胺代谢变化的易感性各不相同。尽管既往综述已研究过多胺在单个神经退行性疾病中的作用，但很少有研究在更广泛的神经退行性蛋白病谱系中比较其作用。我们通过综合多种疾病的证据来填补这一空白，探讨多胺如何影响疾病相关蛋白的聚集和清除，以及这些效应如何取决于多胺种类、浓度、细胞背景、疾病阶段、亚细胞定位、氧化还原状态以及溶酶体和线粒体能力。人类组织和生物体液研究报告了多胺代谢物、通路酶和转运体重塑随神经退行性疾病而发生的疾病相关变化。机制研究表明，亚精胺和精胺可以改变多种神经毒性蛋白的组装、凝聚、区室化和清除，而腐胺的作用则更依赖于系统和浓度。这些效应涉及共享通路和不同机制，取决于蛋白质身份、细胞类型和亚细胞定位。有趣的是，多胺干预在一种情境下可能具有保护作用，而在另一种情境下则可能有害。我们提出的框架可以区分适应性重塑与致病性失调，并指导与疾病相关的治疗策略。
items.frontierRationale: 该综述新近整合多胺代谢在多种神经退行性蛋白病（包括ALS）中的比较证据，提出可区分适应性重塑与致病性失调的框架，对ALS蛋白稳态和溶酶体-线粒体交叉机制研究具有转化指导价值。

items.title: Biomarker-Guided Diagnosis of Riboflavin Transporter Deficiency Presenting as Seronegative Myasthenia Gravis: A Short Report from a Consanguineous Family.
items.summary: Brown-Vialetto-Van Laere syndrome (BVVLS) is a rare, treatable neurodegenerative disorder caused by riboflavin transporter gene variants (SLC52A2, SLC52A3). Early symptoms can mimic neuromuscular junction disorders, causing diagnostic delays. A 3.5-year-old girl from consanguineous parents presented at 2.5 years with isolated bilateral ptosis, later developing dysphagia, dysphonia, facial diplegia, stridor, and respiratory compromise. Examination revealed tongue atrophy with fasciculations and bulbar weakness but normal limb strength. Diagnosed with seronegative myasthenia gravis, she failed to respond to corticosteroids, pyridostigmine, salbutamol, and intravenous immunoglobulin. Absence of fatigability, lower motor neuron signs, and a sibling history of hearing loss and bulbar palsy prompted genetic testing revealed a homozygous missense variant in SLC52A3 (c.670T > C; p.Phe224Leu). High-dose riboflavin (up to 50 mg/kg/day) led to gradual improvement in bulbar function, resolution of stridor, and respiratory stabilization, though ptosis and tongue fasciculations persisted. This report is novel in using clinical response to riboflavin as a functional biomarker for riboflavin transporter deficiency (RTD) in a patient with a variant of uncertain significance, unlike prior cases with definitive genetics. Empiric riboflavin challenge offers a practical framework when genetic results are ambiguous. RTD should be suspected in children with treatment-resistant, non-fluctuating ptosis and bulbar weakness, particularly with consanguinity or family history of hearing loss and bulbar palsy. Early high-dose riboflavin prevents decline, while immunosuppression is ineffective and potentially harmful.

items.summaryZh: 本报告描述一名近亲婚配家庭的3.5岁女孩，早期表现为双侧上睑下垂，后被误诊为血清阴性重症肌无力，对多种免疫治疗无反应。基因检测发现SLC52A3纯合错义变异，确诊为核黄素转运体缺乏症（Brown-Vialetto-Van Laere综合征）。大剂量核黄素治疗后延髓功能和呼吸状况改善，但上睑下垂和舌肌束颤动持续。作者提出，在基因结果不明确时，经验性核黄素激发试验可作为功能性生物标志物辅助诊断。

items.abstractZh: Brown-Vialetto-Van Laere综合征（BVVLS）是一种罕见的、可治疗的神经退行性疾病，由核黄素转运体基因变异（SLC52A2、SLC52A3）引起。早期症状可模仿神经肌肉接头疾病，导致诊断延迟。一名来自近亲婚配父母的3.5岁女孩在2.5岁时表现为孤立性双侧上睑下垂，随后出现吞咽困难、发声困难、双侧面瘫、喘鸣和呼吸功能受损。检查发现舌萎缩伴肌束颤动和延髓肌无力，但肢体肌力正常。被诊断为血清阴性重症肌无力，对皮质类固醇、吡啶斯的明、沙丁胺醇和静脉注射免疫球蛋白均无反应。无疲劳性、下运动神经元体征以及同胞有听力损失和延髓性麻痹病史促使进行基因检测，发现SLC52A3纯合错义变异（c.670T > C；p.Phe224Leu）。大剂量核黄素（高达50 mg/kg/天）使延髓功能逐渐改善，喘鸣消失，呼吸稳定，但上睑下垂和舌肌束颤动持续存在。本报告的新颖之处在于，在一名携带意义未明变异的患者中，将核黄素临床反应用作核黄素转运体缺乏症（RTD）的功能性生物标志物，这与先前具有明确遗传学证据的病例不同。当遗传结果不明确时，经验性核黄素激发试验提供了实用框架。对于治疗抵抗、非波动性上睑下垂和延髓肌无力的儿童，尤其是有近亲婚配或听力损失和延髓性麻痹家族史者，应怀疑RTD。早期大剂量核黄素可防止病情恶化，而免疫抑制无效且可能有害。
items.frontierRationale: 该报告提出以核黄素临床反应作为意义未明变异患者的功能性生物标志物，为可治疗神经退行性疾病的早期识别提供了新近的转化思路。

items.title: Mitochondrial dysfunction in neurology: biomarkers and clinical implications.
items.summary: Mitochondrial dysfunction is increasingly recognized as a shared downstream pathogenic mechanism across a wide spectrum of neurological disorders, ranging from primary mitochondrial diseases to conditions including amyotrophic lateral sclerosis, Alzheimer disease, Parkinson disease, multiple sclerosis, hereditary ataxias and idiopathic inflammatory myopathies. This Review examines the role of mitochondrial biomarkers in improving diagnostic accuracy, patient stratification and monitoring of disease progression and therapeutic response. Primary mitochondrial diseases are presented as proof-of-concept models of impaired oxidative phosphorylation, providing a framework for biomarker identification and validation with translational relevance to other neurological diseases. Mitochondrial biomarkers can be broadly categorized into four domains: fluid biomarkers, reflecting metabolic alterations and stress signalling; genetic biomarkers, capturing mitochondrial DNA integrity and dynamics; multi-omics approaches, integrating transcriptomic, proteomic and metabolomic signatures; and imaging biomarkers, enabling in vivo assessment of structural and functional consequences of mitochondrial dysfunction. Across disorders, these biomarkers reveal shared disturbances in bioenergetics, redox homeostasis, mitochondrial genome maintenance and inflammatory signalling. However, clinical implementation remains limited by methodological heterogeneity, biological variability and reduced disease specificity. Integrated, multimodal biomarker strategies, combined with longitudinal validation, will be essential for supporting precision medicine and guiding the development of therapies to target mitochondrial pathways in neurology.

items.title: Drosophila Models of Human Neurodegenerative Diseases.
items.summary: In his book Insects and the Life of Man: Collected Essays on Pure Science and Applied Biology, Sir V. B. Wigglesworth examined how a fundamental understanding of insect physiology and biology can be applied to some of society's greatest challenges, including human health. Here we reflect on how, in the 50 years since his book's publication, Drosophila melanogaster have played a critical role in advancing our understanding of human neurodegenerative diseases. Focusing on Parkinson's disease, Huntington's disease, and the frontotemporal dementia / amyotrophic lateral sclerosis spectrum, we examine the role Drosophila have played in elucidating fundamental mechanisms of neurodegeneration, identifying therapeutic targets, and dissecting the complex interplay that exists between genetics and environmental factors. Together these studies highlight how Drosophila models continue to provide critical insight into the molecular mechanisms underpinning neurodegeneration and provide a fundamental pre-clinical model in which we can accelerate research into human neurodegenerative conditions.

items.title: Neurodegeneration in Sub-Saharan Africa: Intersections of Biological Ageing, Genomic Diversity and the Lifetime Exposome.
items.summary: Neurodegenerative diseases are emerging as an important consequence of population ageing in sub-Saharan Africa (SSA), but their scientific relevance extends beyond a projected rise in case numbers. SSA combines exceptional human genomic diversity with marked heterogeneity in vascular and metabolic risk, infection, nutrition, occupational exposures, air pollution, and access to health care. This combination creates an underused setting in which to study why biological ageing produces neurodegeneration in some individuals but relative resilience in others. This review critically synthesises evidence on Alzheimer's disease and related dementias, Parkinson's disease, amyotrophic lateral sclerosis/frontotemporal degeneration, Huntington's disease and related disorders, focusing on the intersection between hallmarks of ageing, disease-specific proteinopathies, ancestry and the lifetime exposome. Age-associated loss of proteostasis, mitochondrial dysfunction, impaired autophagy, chronic inflammation, neurovascular injury and genomic/epigenomic instability provide a mechanistic scaffold on which genetic susceptibility and cumulative exposures may act. Yet African evidence remains dominated by cross-sectional clinical phenotyping; neuropathology, longitudinal biomarkers, multi-omics and measured environmental exposures remain sparse. Recent African-ancestry Parkinson's disease genomics and emerging plasma biomarker studies demonstrate that ancestry-inclusive molecular neuroscience is feasible and can generate findings not predictable from European-ancestry datasets. The next phase should therefore move beyond documenting underdiagnosis toward longitudinal, biologically anchored cohorts that integrate phenotype, genomics, blood biomarkers, neuroimaging, exposomics, digital measures and health-system outcomes. This review proposes a research framework centred on biological ageing, gene-environment interaction and resilience. Such work would improve the validity of prevention, diagnosis and therapeutic translation in African populations while contributing globally to a more complete biology of neurodegenerative ageing.

items.title: Cellular senescence in ageing and neurodegenerative disorders: Molecular mechanisms, biomarkers, and therapeutic strategies.
items.summary: Cellular senescence has been increasingly associated with neurodegenerative disorders, potentially linking ageing-related cellular impairment with mitochondrial dysfunction, chronic inflammation, and disrupted intercellular signalling. The present study aims to explore the increasing relevance of cellular senescence among key cell types, including neurons, astrocytes, neural progenitor cells, microglia and oligodendrocyte-lineage cells across neurodegenerative ailments such as Alzheimer's disease, Parkinson's disease, amyotrophic lateral sclerosis and multiple sclerosis. This review discusses the findings of pre-clinical and clinical studies which suggest that senescence-associated features may contribute to neurodegeneration. Further, it provides an overview of the biomarkers used in the identification of senescence in the CNS. Also, the review examines senotherapeutic treatment approaches, highlighting their actions on different CNS cell types and the growing clinical evidence. It also points out the challenges in translating these approaches to clinical application, such as targeting specific cell types and the lack of suitable biomarkers. Collectively, present findings suggest that senescence-associated alterations may contribute to neurodegeneration, although their effects appear to vary across cell types and diseases.

items.title: State transitions in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis: mechanistic convergence and biomarker-guided stratification.
items.summary: Biological heterogeneity is a major obstacle to therapeutic development in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS). Cross-sectional pathway labels do not show whether a mechanism is active or treatment-relevant in an individual patient. We conducted a structured critical narrative review informed by the Scale for the Assessment of Narrative Review Articles. MEDLINE, Embase, PubMed, and CENTRAL were searched for English-language literature published from 1 January 2015 to 7 August 2026; seminal earlier studies were identified by citation tracking. Human genetic, pathological, longitudinal biomarker, multi-omic, imaging, neurophysiological, and interventional evidence was prioritized. Evidence was appraised by human proximity, temporality, replication, mechanistic specificity, and treatment relevance. Evidence supports interacting RNA/proteostasis, nucleocytoplasmic-transport, glial-inflammatory, and energetic-metabolic processes, but current evidence does not yet support the use of any candidate state for individual treatment assignment. The most mature temporal example is loss of TDP-43 splicing repression before neurofilament elevation in genetically at-risk individuals. Nucleocytoplasmic-transport evidence is strongest in C9orf72 disease; inflammatory and metabolic signals are confounded by disease burden and systemic illness; and the gut-brain axis remains a context-dependent amplifier. We propose prespecified transition rules, evidence grades, and biomarker-by-treatment interaction tests. A state-transition model becomes clinically useful when longitudinal measurements add value beyond clinical predictors and injury markers and prospectively identify differential treatment benefit.
